name: v6-efa-py
description: Federated exploratory factor analysis on the exact pooled correlation matrix, with KMO, Bartlett's test, minres/ML/principal extraction and varimax/promax/oblimin rotation.

functions.name: efa
functions.description: Federated exploratory factor analysis (minres, ML or principal extraction; varimax, promax or oblimin rotation) on the pooled correlation matrix, with KMO and Bartlett's test

arguments.name: n_factors
arguments.description: Number of factors. Defaults to the Kaiser criterion (eigenvalues > 1).

arguments.name: method
arguments.description: Extraction method: minres (default), ml or principal.

arguments.name: rotation
arguments.description: Rotation: promax (default), oblimin, varimax or none.

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Organizations to include in the analysis. Defaults to all organizations in the collaboration.

functions.name: compute_local_moments
functions.description: Number of complete records, column sums and cross-product matrix of the selected columns at one node.
